trials.claim: Includes 1000 credits per month for Enhance and Retouch
trials.claimQuote: 1000 Credits Per Month for Enhance and Retouch
trials.reasoning: The exhibits show a paid Premium plan offers 1000 credits/month and subscriptions have a monthly credit budget, but none ties 1000 credits for Enhance and Retouch to this lifetime deal.

exhibits.quote: Credits will be cleared after your subscription expires.
exhibits.argument: Credits are not kept permanently but are cleared on expiry, limiting the monthly credit promise.

exhibits.quote: Yes, paid users have some limits on the size and dimensions of the photos they upload.
exhibits.argument: Paid credit use is further limited by upload size and dimension restrictions.

exhibits.quote:
Higher monthly credits for active users

$9.9

/Monthly

- 1000 credits/month

- Priority Support
exhibits.argument: The quote shows the Premium plan offers 1000 credits per month.

exhibits.quote: Subscriptions include a monthly credit budget that can roll over to the next month.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms subscriptions provide a monthly credit budget.

trials.claimQuote: ImageColorizer - Colorize B&W photos and restore old pictures: $29.95 (was $299)
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms paying $29.95, but no exhibit verifies the claimed $299 regular price.

exhibits.quote: For subscriptions, you will be charged on the same day each month or year.
exhibits.argument: Vendor sells recurring monthly or yearly subscriptions, undermining a one-time $29.95 price claim.

exhibits.quote: PixageFX costs $19.99 full features. It does more than just image colorization too
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports a full-feature alternative costs $19.99, undermining the $299 regular price anchor.

exhibits.quote: There is no activation code in my user account. Basically, there is no activation code. Basically, I've lost $29.95.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms a buyer paid $29.95 for the plan.

trials.claim: Uses AI algorithms to add color to B&W pictures and restore old photos
trials.claimQuote: ImageColorizer is using the latest AI algorithms to add color to B&W pictures and restore old photos
trials.reasoning: The vendor states the product uses AI colorization and restoration for black-and-white and old photos; poor color quality in reviews does not show it lacks that AI function.

exhibits.quote: Did this software colour the images... yes... was it great... no. There are greenish horses in the photos.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports AI colorization produces incorrect greenish colors, contradicting realistic AI color claims.

exhibits.quote: Too much green in colorizing and it doesn't matter if you use factor of 40.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports persistent green tint that settings cannot fix, undermining AI color quality.

exhibits.quote: Bring faded family photos and black-and-white pictures back to life with AI colorization, photo restoration, scratch repair, enhancement, and portrait retouching tools.
exhibits.argument: The quote states the product uses AI colorization and photo restoration for black-and-white pictures.

exhibits.quote: The AI colorizer helps recover natural skin tones, clothing, scenery, and background details so old photos feel vivid again.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms AI adds color detail to old photos.

trials.claim: Product colorizes B&W photos and restores old pictures
trials.claimQuote: ImageColorizer - Colorize B&W photos and restore old pictures
trials.reasoning: Buyers report the purchased app could not be activated or stopped working with no support reply, materially undercutting that the delivered product colorizes and restores as described.

exhibits.quote: Upon purchasing and redeeming you will not be given an activation code. Your desktop app will not work.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the purchased product cannot be activated and does not work at all.

exhibits.quote: This app has not worked for two days and I have been trying to contact the developer via there email as instructed and have had no reply
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the app stopped working with no support response, contradicting it works as described.

exhibits.quote: Use ImageColorizer to colorize black-and-white photos, restore faded details, enhance blurry images, retouch portraits, and repair scratches online.
exhibits.argument: The quote directly states the product colorizes black-and-white photos and restores faded details.

exhibits.quote: This tool has both brought them to life (by adding colour) and also repaired them by removing creases and scratches! SIMPLY AMAZING
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the tool adds colour and repairs old photos.

trials.claim: Can unblur old photos to make them look clear
trials.claimQuote: Unblur old photos and make them look clear
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports the result became low-resolution and worse, and the vendor admits results vary by scan quality, materially limiting the promise to unblur photos and make them clear.

exhibits.quote: it took the image and removed ALL the scratches and issues but now the image is so low res/blocky it actually worse than before I started.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports restoration makes the image low-resolution and worse, contradicting clear results.

exhibits.quote: Results vary by the original scan quality, but the tool is designed to increase resolution, sharpen soft areas, and keep important facial and background details recognizable.
exhibits.argument: Vendor admits results vary by scan quality, so clear unblurred results are not guaranteed.

exhibits.quote: Sharpen blurry photos, improve clarity, and enhance old portraits.
exhibits.argument: The quote states the tool sharpens blurry photos and improves clarity.

exhibits.quote: Use the AI photo enhancer to sharpen soft details, improve contrast, and make low-resolution old photos clearer.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms the enhancer makes old photos clearer.

trials.claim: All photos will be removed within 24 hours
trials.claimQuote: All photos will be removed with 24 hours
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted about photo removal within 24 hours, so the claim cannot be verified either way.
